gloss: action before words; doing rather than talking

definitions.gloss: action before words; quietly getting things done
definitions.explanation: The attitude of doing what needs to be done quietly and steadily, without boasting or announcing it beforehand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不言実行|ふげんじっこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a man of action, not words.

examples.japanese: {不言実行|ふげんじっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦モットー→モットー：29293_mottoo⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I make "action before words" my motto.

examples.japanese: {不言実行|ふげんじっこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{言|い}わ→言う：00515_iu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やり{遂|と}げた→やり遂げる：16745_yaritogeru⟧。
examples.english: True to "action over words," he completed the difficult job without a single complaint.

notes:
A four-character idiom (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) made of {不言|ふげん} (not speaking) + ⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧ (carrying out). It praises people who act quietly instead of making big declarations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不言実行|ふげんじっこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person who acts without talking
- {不言実行|ふげんじっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧: to aim to act rather than talk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有言実行|ゆうげんじっこう}→有言実行：06148_yuugenjikkou⟧: doing what one has said one will do — the modern counterpart that values declaring goals and then achieving them
- ⟦{言行一致|げんこういっち}→言行一致：29295_genkouicchi⟧: consistency between words and actions
